first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: First-person gun holder, with a beige sleeve, a brown glove with dark padding, and fingers partially visible.

entities.name: light-brown courtyard road
entities.identification: Light-brown to gray-brown paved ground in the courtyard, with a curb, wear, and scattered debris.

entities.name: high-walled building with blue-gray trim
entities.identification: High-walled beige building on the image-left, with a wide blue-gray band, small upper arched windows, and a rounded projecting wall corner.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: Dilapidated light blue-gray sedan on the image-left, with a rusted body and openings at the windows and side exposing the interior.

entities.name: pile of bag-like bundles and light-colored wooden crates
entities.identification: Multiple layers of brown rectangular bundles stacked on worn light-colored wooden crates, with the edges of the bundles slightly bulging.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: Old brown vehicle behind the canopy and metal mesh on the image-right, with only part of the body visible.

entities.name: courtyard wall
entities.identification: Beige courtyard wall at center-right, with light-colored papers attached, scattered dark bullet-mark-like spots, and coils of wire along the top.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: Black long rifle held from the first-person perspective, with a long top rail, ring-shaped rear sight, upright front sight, and gray-white mottling.

entities.name: arched courtyard side gate
entities.identification: Narrow arched doorway behind and toward the image-right of the stacked objects, with steps in front of the doorway.

entities.name: yellow human-shaped outline marker
entities.identification: Multiple glowing human-shaped outlines in the projected area on the image-left wall, colored yellow-orange.

entities.name: blue trajectory line
entities.identification: Bright blue curved line extending toward the upper image-right from near the stacked objects and doorway.

entities.name: overhead power lines
entities.identification: Multiple thin dark lines crossing and extending through the air above the canopy at the upper image-right.

entities.name: wall-top trees
entities.identification: Background vegetation group composed of dark green broadleaf canopies and yellow-green palm fronds visible behind the wall.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: Light blue to nearly white sky visible between the buildings, wall, and tree canopies.

entities.name: low courtyard canopy
entities.identification: Dark low canopy above the opening on the image-right, with crossbeams and metal mesh in front.
